gate_specification.pipeline_position: Primary gate, executed strictly before G1_DELAY_FEASIBILITY

rejection_reason_templates.DISALLOWED: Prohibited by physical structural mask (status=0): no physical connection {source} -> {target}.
rejection_reason_templates.UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVE: Rejected under conservative policy (status=?): unverified physical connection {source} -> {target}.

swat_operational_policy.description: Conservative mode for SWaT A4/A5 Stage 2. Rejects unverified candidate edges to prevent correlation hallucination.

legacy_compatibility_policy.description: Preserves backward compatibility for MetroPT-3 and synthetic benchmarks without imposing SWaT physical prior.

unexcited_actuator_specification.prior_weight_role: Configurable design parameter representing structural piping presence, NOT an empirically validated probability or confidence.

triggering_conditions: Any edge in traversed paths has is_unexcited_actuator=True or state=EdgeState.UNEXCITED_PRIOR
Any node in traversed paths is in unexcited_actuators set
Active graph has edges directly to target originating from unexcited actuators
Target node has zero active dynamic paths, but physical structural mask confirms permitted physical connection (status=1) from an unexcited actuator
cri_safety_specification.safety_guarantee: Zero empirical variance during normal baseline never results in a silent zero-risk conclusion for downstream target machines.
